system.description: You etch a 10'-diameter ring of glowing runes into a solid surface, pinning local reality to a place you have visited before.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but the portal stays open for 1 minute.
outcomes.success: A shimmering portal on the ground leads to that place. It stays stable for d6 rounds, and any creature can pass through.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and materials are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The portal opens somewhere else, and something on the other side steps through first. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
